components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action with a warm signal background.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-foreground); font: 700 1rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--motion-fast, 150ms) var(--motion-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.92); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Link
components.description: Quiet outlined action for adjacent navigation or lower-priority work.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 700 1rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact labeled field for newsletter and contact flows.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 700 .875rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-text-primary); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 28%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky evidence-led shell with brand, routes, theme action, and mobile panel.
components.html: PM Piyush MehtaWorkWriting
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-card-border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bg) 86%, transparent); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 700 .92rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 8%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-nav-brand { color: var(--color-text-primary); }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: Tonal container for a case study, notebook entry, or measurable outcome.
components.html:
Outcome

Evidence before adjectives

Show the decision, constraint, and result.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--color-accent); font: 800 .8rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 1.35rem/1.2 Muli, sans-serif; } .ds-card p:last-child { color: var(--color-text-secondary); line-height: 1.625; }

narrative.overview:
PiyushMehta.com is a public engineering record, not a generic personal brand template. The visual system treats every page as a legible ledger of decisions: cool ink surfaces hold the work, warm amber marks the signal, and typography carries the authority. The result is technical and editorial without pretending to be a dashboard. It should feel useful to an engineering leader evaluating judgment, a reader staying with a difficult idea, or a collaborator looking for proof.

The incumbent world is compact at the navigation level and spacious at section boundaries. It uses a dark-first palette with a warm paper/light theme, semantic tokens shared across both, and small tonal shifts rather than decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Cool ink surfaces with a rare amber signal
Muli for voice; Source Code Pro for code and measured data
Tonal layering and thin borders before heavy shadows
Responsive grids that collapse deliberately at 920px and 620px

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Use the accent to mark decisions and actions, not to decorate every surface. Let neutral hierarchy do most of the speaking.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Dark and light themes share semantic roles, but each theme chooses its own readable ink, surface, border, and signal values.

rules.name: The Weight Before Color Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with size, weight, and spacing first; use the accent for a precise semantic distinction.

rules.name: The Code Means Code Rule
rules.body: Use the monospace face for source, commands, dates, metrics, and other measured artifacts only.

rules.name: The Quiet Rest Rule
rules.body: A surface should be visually calm before interaction. Depth appears through tonal separation, borders, and purposeful hover/focus state.

dos: Do make the evidence, constraint, tradeoff, or outcome the visual focal point.
Do use semantic theme tokens from src/styles/global.css.
Do preserve the dark ink / warm paper theme pairing.
Do keep focus states visible and mobile panels keyboard-operable.
Do use authored SVG icons with consistent stroke weight.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, clients, metrics, credentials, or outcomes.

Don't use gradient text as decoration; background gradients may remain where they are part of an existing surface. Don't make emoji or Unicode glyphs the default icon system; existing content-specific status glyphs are legacy exceptions.
Don't animate width or height when a transform can express the same state.
Don't use bounce or spring motion for ordinary interaction.
Don't use thick colored side borders on cards, callouts, list items, or alerts.
Don't turn every section into identical icon-plus-heading cards.
